rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Return Inside Finally Block
rules.description: Avoid using unstructured control flow statements (return, continue, or break) inside a 'finally' block.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: If a conditional expression always evaluates to true or always evaluates to false, this suggests incomplete code or a logic error.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.

rules.cwe_name: Download of Code Without Integrity Check
rules.description: Enabling allowRunningInsecureContent can allow remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.description: Sensitive cookies set by a server can be read by the client if the `httpOnly` flag is not set.

rules.cwe_name: Storage of File with Sensitive Data Under Web Root
rules.description: Exposing a node_modules folder, or the project folder to the public, can cause exposure of private information.

rules.cwe_name: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings
rules.description: Placing sensitive data in a GET request increases the risk of the data being exposed to an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: If a conditional expression always evaluates to true or always evaluates to false, this suggests incomplete code or a logic error.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Comparing different kinds of HTTP request data may be a symptom of an insufficient security check.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: Conditional comments are an IE-specific feature and not portable.

rules.cwe_name: Download of Code Without Integrity Check
rules.description: Enabling allowRunningInsecureContent can allow remote code execution.
